system.description:
When you penetrate the mind of your enemy, you can keep your barbs there for a long time.

Prerequisite: Bothan

Effect: Whenever you make a successful Persuasion check against a target's Will Defense, you gain Favourable Circumstances on future Persuasion checks against that target for the next 24 hours.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
